INSERT INTO monthly_sales_summary ( target_month, store_id, product_id, total_amount, total_quantity ) VALUES
(#{row.targetMonth}, #{row.storeId}, #{row.productId}, #{row.totalAmount}, #{row.totalQuantity})
AS added ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_amount = monthly_sales_summary.total_amount + added.total_amount, total_quantity = monthly_sales_summary.total_quantity + added.total_quantity
